text: {"memo": "As of March 31, 2025, AMD’s most recently completed fiscal year was calendar 2024. FY2024 revenue rose 4% year over year to $25.8 billion, from $22.7 billion in FY2023, while GAAP net income was about $2.6 billion and diluted EPS was $1.39. Gross margin was roughly 49%, and operating margin about 36%. Cash flow from operations was strong, though memory-driven inventory dynamics pressured results. In FY2023, AMD generated $22.7 billion revenue, up 1% from $18.7 billion in FY2022, with net income of about $1.3 billion and EPS of $0.75. Gross margin was about 44%. FY2022 revenue was $18.7 billion, up 28% from $16.4 billion in FY2021, and net income was about $1.8 billion, or EPS $1.08, with gross margin near 49%. The business showed resilient AI and data-center growth, but AMD’s client processor and console markets faced tough compares. The stock likely remains a high-momentum semiconductor play, though valuation and competitive risks are elevated."}
